I’m hoping to make what I make into a cookbook that gets sold, but alas, I don’t know how and my TikTok and Instagram isn’t taking off the way I hoped. Oh well, at least I’ll have my recipes….and ya’ll, you beautiful bastards! FP Edit: WHOAH! I was not expecting this to hit FP. They are all on one google doc now. It was fun going through. I’ve improved so much since I started my hot sauce making journey. I saw many critiques and kind words from this community. I made about 25 different sauces. I lost the recipe to one so I hope I can find it again. Another edit: okay, it looks like people are genuinely interested in me making a book. I’m going through the steps to see about making a cookbook and maybe a website.
